title: Blow to the CJNG: 20 Members Fall in 3 States; They Had Weapons, Drugs, Tigers…
author: Redacción SinEmbargo
content:
_This article originally appeared in the[August 24, 2026 edition of
SinEmbargo](https://www.sinembargo.mx/4859112/trancazo-al-cjng-
caen-20-integrantes-en-3-estados-tenian-armas-drogas-tigres), a Mexican
digital news outlet._

**Mexico City, August 24 (SinEmbargo).—** Omar García Harfuch, head of the
Secretariat of Security and Citizen Protection (SSPC), announced this Monday
morning the arrest of **20 alleged members of the Jalisco New Generation
Cartel (CJNG)** during simultaneous operations at **36 properties** in
Hidalgo, Jalisco, and Michoacán.

Through his account on X, formerly Twitter, he reported that in the operations
carried out by the SSPC, the Secretariat of National Defense (Defensa), the
Secretariat of the Navy (Semar), the Attorney General's Office (FGR), and the
National Guard (GN), "firearms, drugs, 113 vehicles, tigers, panthers, other
animals and birds kept in inadequate conditions, cash, communications
equipment, a drone, and a drone jammer, among other items, were seized."

> [Post by @OHarfuch on
> X](https://twitter.com/OHarfuch/status/2091878411232759872)

"With these arrests and those carried out in the precision operation this past
August 19, led by the Mexican Army, the number of members of this organization
detained now totals 32," García Harfuch stressed.

He also clarified the purpose of the Mexican Government's Security Cabinet's
actions:

> The goal is not merely to apprehend generators of violence, but to
> sustainably weaken the operational, logistical, and financial capabilities
> of criminal organizations.
>
> Omar García Harfuch
